what-line: A LOOP is a few steps, played again with one change, until you are back where you started.
what-small: You make the first part. The LOOP makes the rest.
five-line: Every LOOP type is one change. Here is the same step under each.
line-rotated: The same steps again, turned halfway around.
line-reflected: The same steps again, reflected across a line through the centre.
line-swapped: The same steps again, with your hands trading jobs.
line-inverted: Your hands take the same paths again. Every spin goes the other way.
line-rewound: The same steps again, backwards, back the way you came.
lines-line: Pick the line. Everything on one side trades places with the other.
times-line: A half turn, done twice, is a full turn. A quarter turn takes four.
times-small: That is why a longer LOOP comes from a smaller turn.
